faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar) for a temporary project position in Gujarat.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: IIT Gandhinagar has advertised for the position of Project Scientist-II under project reference SPON/10523/Advt0335 for research work.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Project Scientist-II?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Scientist-II position under this particular recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Project Scientist-II?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. or M.Tech./M.S. in Power Electronics, Electrical, Electronics, ECE, or E&TC Engineering with 03 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Project Scientist-II posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of ₹85,090/- per month, which includes the House Rent Allowance components.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for IIT Gandhinagar recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Project Scientist-II recruitment is 09-10-2026. Make sure to apply on time.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly online. Interested candidates must submit their applications through the designated recruitment portal of IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification released by IIT Gandhinagar for the Project Scientist-II recruitment process.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I apply online for IIT Gandhinagar Project Scientist-II?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official recruitment website at http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/ before the deadline.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this IIT Gandhinagar opening?
faq.answer: The position of Project Scientist-II is temporary and associated with the project titled 'Development of a Fuel Cell Powerpack for High Altitude Platform'.
